premises.text: People in my generation have difficulty tracking their spending.
premises.evidence_span: I have a problem, something shared by most, if not all, of my generation. I have no idea where my money goes.

premises.text: Fast input of expenses is essential for effective budgeting.
premises.evidence_span: I want you to be able to whip out your phone and input any expense in under three seconds.

premises.text: Anonymity in financial tracking is important.
premises.evidence_span: We'll never ask you for your credit card or bank information, not even your name.

premises.text: Being proactive about finances engages users.
premises.evidence_span: When it comes to your finances, we believe that being proactive is the key.

premises.text: Gamification can encourage users to track their spending.
premises.evidence_span: Gen Y, or my generation, is all about playing games. It only makes sense if we add those same principles to encourage them to track their cash.

premises.text: Tracking spending patterns can help users understand their habits.
premises.evidence_span: Spends tracks both the pattern and frequency of my top tags and intuitively responds.

premises.text: Achievements and rewards can motivate users to develop better spending habits.
premises.evidence_span: Achievements are ways that we encourage our users to do some great spending habits.

premises.text: Subcategorization of budgets allows for better tracking of specific expenses.
Demographic insights can help users compare their spending to peers.
premises.evidence_span: with the you versus them feature, I can show you insights like never before.

premises.text: Spends will always be free for users.
premises.evidence_span: For users, Spends will always be free.

value.text: Users can track their spending in a fun, fast, and anonymous way.

notes: No external knowledge applied; all claims are based on the transcript.
